pokedexEntries.go: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

pokedexEntries.si: If it smells something enticing, it dashes headlong off to find the source of the aroma.

pokedexEntries.cr: It uses the tip of its nose to dig for food. Its nose is so tough that even frozen ground poses no problem.

pokedexEntries.rs: SWINUB roots for food by rubbing its snout against the ground. Its favorite food is a mushroom that grows under the cover of dead grass. This POKéMON occasionally roots out hot springs.

pokedexEntries.em: It roots for food by rubbing its snout against the ground. Its favorite food is a mushroom that grows under dried grass. It occasionally roots out hot springs.

pokedexEntries.dp: It loves eating mushrooms that grow under dead grass. It also finds hot springs while foraging.

pokedexEntries.pt: It has a very sensitive nose. It can locate mushrooms, berries, and even hot springs buried under ice.
